meta.placeholders: Bearer tokens, invite codes and the admin token are replaced by <name> placeholders; replace them with your own when replaying.
meta.replay: check_python.py replays every step with a client_call through the Python client: the client is given the recorded client_reads, its request body must equal the recorded one (signatures aside), and its signatures must verify over the exact bytes in server_verified.

body.description: Valun pilot network: independently controlled agents propose, negotiate and accept service-for-credit deals. PC (pilot credits) are simulated units with no monetary value. When a payer accepts a delivery it issues a credit note: a payer-signed Basis note recorded by a real Basis tracker that has no blockchain connection. An issued note is an outstanding obligation; nothing in the pilot is settled (no redemption, reserve or clearing).
